title: IQ QUEST Battle Pool Easy B
creator: IQ QUEST · Powered by IQ Labs
theme: Fifteen independent easy battle puzzles, each with complete rules and no story dependencies. A fresh combination can challenge friends to beat your time.

levels.title: 01 · The Moving Alphabet
levels.q: A lock uses a Caesar cipher: each plain letter is shifted 4 places FORWARD (Z wraps to A). It shows FVMHKI. Move every letter BACK 4 places. What word is revealed?
levels.h: Work letter by letter and remember to wrap around the alphabet.

levels.title: 02 · The Mirror Word
levels.q: A mirror alphabet pairs A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X and so on. Decode NLLM using this alphabet. Enter the original English word.
levels.h: The positions from opposite ends of the alphabet add to 27 if A is position 1.

levels.title: 03 · The Growing Steps
levels.q: The steps are numbered 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, ?. Every difference is identical. What number is on the NEXT step?
levels.h: Compare two consecutive differences, then apply that same change again.

levels.title: 04 · The Letter Grid
levels.q: Five rows read ABCDE / FGHIJ / KLMNO / PQRST / UVWXY. Start at the center M (row 3, column 3). Move S → W → N → W one tile per arrow (N=up, S=down, E=right, W=left). Which LETTER is your final tile?
levels.h: Mark your position after every move on the 5×5 grid; move in the grid, not alphabet order.

levels.title: 05 · The Twelve-Hour Dial
levels.q: A 12-hour clock shows 11:00. Advance it 5 hours. The dial wraps after 12. Which hour (1–12) does it show?
levels.h: Move around a clock face rather than counting beyond 12.

levels.title: 06 · The Two Symbols
levels.q: Two symbols hide positive integers. SUN + SUN = 16, and SUN + MOON = 15. What integer is MOON?
levels.h: Find the repeated SUN value first, then substitute into the second equation.

levels.title: 07 · The Binary Plate
levels.q: The plate shows the binary number 111010. Every position is a power of 2 (from right: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32). Convert the WHOLE binary number into decimal. What number is it?
levels.h: Add only the place values where the binary digit is 1.

levels.title: 08 · The Four Scouts
levels.q: Four scouts A, B, C and D stand in one line. A stands first; D stands immediately after B; and C is before B. Which scout is in SECOND place? Enter one letter.
levels.h: Build a four-position row and apply the strongest fixed-position clue first.

levels.title: 09 · The Arithmetic Machine
levels.q: A machine starts at 18. It MULTIPLIES by 4, then SUBTRACTS 7, then ADDS 6. What integer leaves the machine?
levels.h: Do the operations in the order stated, not by standard precedence across the sentence.

levels.title: 10 · Numbers into Letters
levels.q: A1Z26 represents A=1, B=2, ... Z=26. Decode 18-21-14-5 into four capital letters. Enter the word with no hyphens.
levels.h: Convert each number to exactly one letter, then read left to right.

levels.title: 11 · The Missing Tile
levels.q: Each row on a tablet must sum to 24. One row reads 8, 7, ?. Which integer replaces the question mark?
levels.h: Subtract the two visible tile values from the required row total.

levels.title: 12 · The Shortest Walk
levels.q: To reach the exit, a robot must make exactly 4 moves RIGHT and 2 moves UP, in any order. Every shortest path uses all these moves and no others. How many different shortest paths exist?
levels.h: Count how many ways the UP moves can occupy distinct positions among all moves.

levels.title: 13 · The Remainder Lock
levels.q: Find the SMALLEST whole number strictly greater than 30 that leaves remainder 4 when divided by 7. What is the number?
levels.h: Test numbers just above the bound by their remainder, not their quotient.

levels.title: 14 · The Supply Ratio
levels.q: A box contains red and blue crystals in ratio 3:4. There are 28 crystals total. How many are RED?
levels.h: First find the size of one ratio part using the total number of parts.

levels.title: 15 · The Morse Beacon
levels.q: A beacon flashes dots (.) and dashes (-). Decode the four Morse letters .-- / .- / ...- / .. Slashes separate letters. Use this complete legend for the symbols in the message: A=.-, E=., V=...-, W=.--. Enter the four-letter word.
levels.h: Each dot-dash group maps to one letter from the provided legend; keep their original order.
